Each admitted record was encoded in a source-effect matrix with support class, claim-fitness grade, admissible use, prohibited stronger use, compatibility role, and locator limitation. The matrix was synthesized into the research report and then assessed from procedurally role-separated, same-model-family editorial, domain, methodology, and adversarial perspectives before author adjudication. \paragraph{Reader map.} Every edge in this map is prospective. \path{ObjectLedger/v1} validates a serialized projective matrix, subgroup evidence, loxodromic eligibility, and dependency hashes; a conforming eligible row yields \texttt{OBJECT\_INPUT\_VALIDATED}, while malformed input yields \texttt{OBJECT\_ROW\_MALFORMED} and ineligibility yields \texttt{OBJECT\_ROW\_INELIGIBLE\_EXCLUDED}. Gate~Q may map validated inputs to oriented primitive classes and then canonical unoriented owners only after complete root, conjugacy, inversion, and reconciliation decisions; otherwise it emits the quotient-not-certified outcome \texttt{QUOTIENT\_NOT\_EVALUABLE} or the resource-bounded \texttt{QUOTIENT\_UNRESOLVED\_STOP}. Gate~M consumes only certified owners and one immutable candidate record and emits exactly \texttt{MECHANISM\_ADMISSIBLE}, \texttt{SPLIT\_IDEAL\_CODOMAIN\_OBSTRUCTION}, or \texttt{FORMAL\_MAP\_REFUTED} under the declared precedence. \path{PerformanceLedger/v1} may then emit a schema-valid empty/result skeleton, or stop as \texttt{PERFORMANCE\_POPULATION\_HASH\_MISMATCH\_STOP}, \texttt{PERFORMANCE\_MECHANISM\_HASH\_MISMATCH\_STOP}, \texttt{PERFORMANCE\_POST\_FREEZE\_MUTATION\_STOP}, or \texttt{PERFORMANCE\_POPULATION\_RECONCILIATION\_STOP}. \path{IndependentReplayReceipt/v1} emits \texttt{REPLAY\_PASS} only after every expected disposition and dependency hash agrees; otherwise it emits \texttt{REPLAY\_FIRST\_MISMATCH\_STOP} with the first mismatch. Any missing or stopped node prohibits every downstream use. No mapped output has been observed.

\paragraph{Prospective control interpretation.} Each control and stop below is unexecuted. An owner-label permutation preserves the quotient and tests scoring sensitivity to label identity; failure produces \texttt{CONTROL\_LABEL\_DEPENDENCE\_STOP}, diagnoses label dependence, and cannot establish arithmetic specificity. An inversion-paired control preserves the underlying owner population while testing representative invariance; failure produces \texttt{CONTROL\_REPRESENTATIVE\_INVARIANCE\_STOP}, diagnoses an owner-law or serialization defect, and cannot identify the correct ideal branch. A broadened-codomain control, such as an unordered conjugate pair, changes the output type; noncomparability produces \texttt{CONTROL\_CODOMAIN\_COMPARABILITY\_STOP} and cannot rescue the registered single-ideal mechanism, count as performance under the frozen estimand, or establish an all-codomain obstruction. Every construction, statistic, tolerance, and expected disposition remains a pre-output registration obligation, and neither a control result nor any listed stop has been observed.
